DRG 963 Other Multiple Significant Trauma with MCC
DRG 964 Other Multiple Significant Trauma with CC
DRG 965 Other Multiple Significant Trauma without CC/MCC

Any diagnosis of significant head trauma, significant chest trauma, significant abdominal
trauma, significant kidney trauma, significant trauma of the urinary system, significant
trauma of the pelvis or spine, significant trauma of the upper limb, or significant trauma
of the lower limb. See MDC 24 Principal Diagnosis Listings for details.
